title: Evening Sunwatch
text:
🌇 Evening Sunwatch — November 26, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.0)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B3.3 (Peaked November 26, 2026 at 15:46 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 297 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

All quiet on the Sunwatch front. 👀🖤💫

A broad dark coronal feature and modest bright EUV regions are visible, with no clearly notable outward structure in the coronagraph.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
